note.#text: Born in Northampton, Massachusetts, November 23, 1819, son of Josiah Dwight and Sarah (Williston), graduated Yale 1839, read law 1841, traveled and studied in France, Germany, Italy, 1842-45, worked survey of mineral lands of Northern Peninsula of Michigan, Geologist of California, opened School of Mining and Practical Geology at Harvard, served as Sturgis Hooper Profesor of Geology at Harvard; elected to Geological Society of. Author of Metal Wealth of the United States and other books, Mt. Whitney in New Hampshire is named after him. Died at Lake Sunapee, New Hampshire on August 19, 1896.--American National Biography WWW site.
Josiah D. Whitney volume of guitar music (approximately 1829-1855) (Mus 426.1) Merritt Room, Eda Kuhn Loeb Music Library, Harvard University.
